panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: Node CPU utilisation = cpustat.cpu (object=nodes), as a percentage.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r._field == "cpu" and r.object == "nodes")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 100.0 }))

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal") and r.object == "nodes")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: [], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: r.memused * 100.0 / r.memtotal }))

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r._field == "avg1" and r.object == "nodes")
  |> last()

panels.title: Host Uptime
panels.description: Node uptime = system.uptime (object=nodes). A reset means the Proxmox host rebooted.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "uptime" and r.object == "nodes")
  |> last()

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and r._field == "cpu" and r.object == "nodes")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 100.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory" and (r._field == "memused" or r._field == "memtotal") and r.object == "nodes")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r.memused * 100.0 / r.memtotal }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat" and (r._field == "avg1" or r._field == "avg5" or r._field == "avg15") and r.object == "nodes")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Host Network (bits/s)
panels.description: Node NIC throughput = derivative of nics.netin/netout (object=nodes) × 8.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "nodes" and (r._field == "netin" or r._field == "netout"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 8.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: VMs Running
panels.description: Count of QEMU VMs reporting status=running.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "status" and r.object == "qemu")
  |> group(columns: ["host", "vmid"])
  |> last()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == "running")
  |> group()
  |> count()

panels.title: VM Inventory
panels.description: Per-VM CPU %, memory used %, memory allocated and uptime (system measurement, object=qemu).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "qemu" and (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "mem" or r._field == "maxmem" or r._field == "uptime"))
  |> group(columns: ["host", "vmid", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["host", "vmid"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ host: r.host, vmid: r.vmid, cpu_pct: r.cpu * 100.0, mem_pct: if r.maxmem > 0 then r.mem * 100.0 / r.maxmem else 0.0, mem_gib: r.mem / 1073741824.0, maxmem_gib: r.maxmem / 1073741824.0, uptime_h: r.uptime / 3600.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["host", "vmid", "cpu_pct", "mem_pct", "mem_gib", "maxmem_gib", "uptime_h"])

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "cpu" and r.object == "qemu")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 100.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["host"])

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.object == "qemu" and (r._field == "mem" or r._field == "maxmem"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r.mem * 100.0 / r.maxmem }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: VM Uptime (reset = reboot)
panels.description: system.uptime per VM. A sawtooth reset means the VM rebooted — the jump the Proxmox host caused on 2026-09-17 is visible here.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "uptime" and r.object == "qemu")
  |> group(columns: ["host"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.object == "qemu" and (r._field == "netin" or r._field == "netout"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 8.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: VM Disk I/O (B/s)
panels.description: Per-VM disk throughput = derivative of blockstat.rd_bytes/wr_bytes (object=qemu).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.object == "qemu" and (r._field == "rd_bytes" or r._field == "wr_bytes"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "proxmox_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r._field == "status" and r.object == "qemu")
  |> group(columns: ["host", "vmid"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["host", "vmid", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "status"})
